coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No registration duty for household employers found. Employment Act 2023 (Act 15) applies to all employers; ILO (2026) says a national steering committee on C189 is promoting standard domestic-worker contracts (aspiration, no rule yet). NASSIT registration for households not confirmed (only unreliable commercial sites). Watch item, no candidate. https://www.ilo.org/resource/news/sierra-leone-strengthens-protections-and-decent-work-domestic-workers-0

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: One search returned only other countries (Kenya, South Africa, Trinidad). No Sierra Leone scrap dealer licensing regime found; unverified.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No search spent (budget); no sign in other results of a licensing regime.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02/K06/K09 (MCAS covers export valuation). No search spent.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: SLRSA 2024 fee regulations list a 'spare parts registration' fee (2,000) and 'attestation' (3,000), which hints at a registration for parts dealers, but one search found no rule text. Unverified candidate recorded. https://sierralii.gov.sl/akn/sl/act/si/2024/10/eng@2024-08-06

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Slaughter/livestock search returned only Freetown Slaughter House Bye-Laws 1998 (butcher registration, vet certification); no livestock movement permit rule found.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Freetown Municipality Slaughter House Bye-Laws 1998 (Gazette 47): butcher and assistant registration, health certificate, vet fitness certification; repeal status unknown. Weak, small-ticket. https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/sl/national-legislation/freetown-municipality-slaughter-house-bye-laws-1998-public-notice

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No search spent (budget); low prior for a registered duty.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: One search found no Sierra Leone veterinary council act or vet-drug-shop rule (only Botswana, Zimbabwe, Nigeria). Pharmacy Board (Pharmacy and Drugs Act 2001) covers human medicines; K03 already covers pharmacy outlets. Unverified.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: National Water Resources Management Agency Act 2017 requires a permit for mechanical abstraction; Ground Water Development and Protection Regulations 2021 (S.I. 12 of 2021) set drilling licence categories, register, renewal, well registration, well records, water-quality analysis. Number of licensed drillers unknown. https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/sl/national-legislation/national-water-resources-management-agency-groundwater

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Freetown City Council Solid & Liquid Waste Collection Byelaws 2024 (S.I. 14 of 2024) in full force (FCC notice 9 June 2026): households and businesses must register with an FCC-approved provider; households must desludge septic tanks; fine up to NLe 5,000 or 6 months; police MoU. Only about 5 approved providers named. fcc.gov.sl byelaw page was suspended when fetched. https://awokonewspapersl.com/fcc-rolls-out-operation-dorti-mus-go-to-enforce-tough-new-sanitation-byelaws/

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: No search spent (budget); lifts/boilers a very small market in Sierra Leone.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget); only the groundwater licence regime from cat 10 was seen.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: National Fertiliser Regulatory Agency Act 2018 and National Fertiliser Regulations 2019/2020: licences to manufacture, import and distribute fertiliser, inspection, stop-sale, register, fees. Over 500 agro-dealers registered on a 3-year licence (undated article, database integrity questioned by parliament). Pesticide regulation weak (FAO TCP/SIL/3803); no named pesticide board found. https://www.premiermedia-sl.com/?p=22083

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Employment Regulations 2023 (S.I. 10 of 2023) regs 49-60 govern private recruitment agencies; ministry (now Employment, Labour and Social Security) met agencies in Aug 2026 on compliance and ILO C181 and plans a review. Overseas Employment and Migrant Workers Act 2022 (bill text; enactment unconfirmed) requires licences for overseas recruitment. Ministry says licences of agencies with no recruitments will not be renewed and bank statements will verify surety funds. Anti-Corruption Commission found registration ineffective and inconsistent. https://awokonewspapersl.com/?p=160579 (403 on fetch; snippet only)

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Only Ebola-era safe burial material found; no current funeral home or cemetery licensing rule. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: International NGOs register with MoPED (annual reports, audits, permit renewals); a draft NGO policy with caps on admin spend and foreign staff was reported (date and adoption unconfirmed). No small-body register duty with a software buyer. https://slonec.com/?p=153679

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: SL Public Transport Authority Act 2023 as amended 2024 (s.33): operators licence valid 5 years, renew in writing at least 3 months before expiry, fine up to NLe 12,000. NRA Annual Circulation Permit Levy (Finance Act 2023 s.11) on commercial vehicles, okada and keke, paid via SLRSA portal or QR. SLRSA on 7 Apr 2026 announced mandatory fitness tests for haulage vehicles, no start date. Nothing beyond K04 for okada/keke. https://www.premiermedia-sl.com/?p=28590

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: BSL operating guidelines for forex bureaux (Other Financial Services Act 2001): licence fees NLe 1,500 spot, NLe 2,500 inward remittance, super-agent collateral NLe 100,000; eligibility limited to companies, co-operatives, statutory bodies. FCC market dues are collected on site; no digital trader registry found. 2025-2026 rule changes not found. https://bsl.gov.sl/operating guidelines for foreign exchange bureaux.pdf

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving school fee 5,000 and tutor fee 1,000 in SLRSA 2024 fee regulations, no licensing detail. Private schools and nurseries: Education Act 2004 ss.15-17 on registration; pre-primary rules are left to regulations I could not find. Tattoo, childminder and hunting outfitter rules not searched. https://old.sierralii.org/node/5140
